form.label: 5. Etikettendrucker — Environmental Device Health
form.description: Catch equipment failing from environmental conditions (heat, humidity) before it fails, by correlating room sensors with device error logs.

html.blockquote: "Etikettendrucker der dieses Jahr aufgrund steigender Temperaturen nicht mehr funktioniert hat."
html.p: A label printer (used for patient/sample labelling — not a cosmetic failure) stopped working this year because the room it sat in got too hot. Nobody was watching room temperature and the printer's own error log together, so the failure looked random until someone put the two timelines side by side after the fact. The same pattern applies to any device with a documented operating range — network cabinets, UPS units, server closets, lab equipment.

panel.title: Data sources needed to build this for real

ul.li: Environmental sensors — room/rack temperature & humidity, from the building management system (BMS/BACnet) or dedicated IoT sensors (same telemetry pattern as the IoT dashboard).
Device / printer logs — SNMP (Printer-MIB) or the vendor's print-server logs for error codes, paper jams, and thermal-shutdown events.
Asset & location data — which room/rack each device physically sits in, so a sensor reading can be joined to the right device.
HVAC / facilities alarms — AC unit faults or scheduled maintenance windows that explain a temperature spike.

panel.title: Example: room temperature vs. printer errors (7 days)

search.query: | makeresults count=7 | streamstats count as i | eval Day=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(7-i)."d"), "%m-%d") | eval "Room temp (°C, Label-Printer-Storage-2)"=case(i<=4, 22+i, i=5, 31, i=6, 34, i=7, 29) | eval "Printer error count"=case(i<=4, 0, i=5, 2, i=6, 9, i=7, 1) | table Day "Room temp (°C, Label-Printer-Storage-2)" "Printer error count"

panel.title: Devices currently trending outside their rated operating range

search.query: | makeresults count=3 | streamstats count as i | eval Device=case(i=1,"Label-Printer-Storage-2",i=2,"Network-Cabinet-B12",i=3,"UPS-Ward4") | eval Location=case(i=1,"Storage room 2, Bldg B",i=2,"IDF closet B12",i=3,"Ward 4 electrical room") | eval "Current temp"=case(i=1,"34°C",i=2,"27°C",i=3,"24°C") | eval "Rated max"=case(i=1,"30°C",i=2,"35°C",i=3,"40°C") | eval Status=case(i=1,"Over rated max — action needed",i=2,"Within range",i=3,"Within range") | table Device Location "Current temp" "Rated max" Status

panel.title: The SPL, once room sensors + device logs are onboarded

html.pre: index=env_sensors sourcetype=bms:temperature | lookup asset_inventory room_id OUTPUT device_name, rated_max_temp_c | where isnotnull(rated_max_temp_c) | eval over_rated=if(temp_c>rated_max_temp_c, 1, 0) | where over_rated=1 | join type=left room_id [ search index=device_logs sourcetype="printer:snmp" error=* | stats count as printer_errors by room_id ] | table _time room_id device_name temp_c rated_max_temp_c printer_errors
html.p: A simple threshold alert on over_rated=1 would have flagged this room days before the printer actually failed.
